name: FOREX_Currency_Power
summary: This EA is a real-time currency power index visualization tool for the five major FOREX currencies (EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, JPY). It calculates and displays relative currency strength using a weighted basket of currency pairs, rendering results as a CGraphic line chart on the chart. It does not open any trades; it serves purely as an analytical dashboard for currency momentum assessment.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个实时货币强弱指标可视化工具，用于展示五大主要外汇货币（EUR、USD、GBP、CHF、JPY）的相对强弱。它通过加权一篮子货币对计算并绘制货币强度曲线图，不执行任何交易操作，纯粹作为货币动量分析的仪表盘使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个货币强弱分析工具。其核心概念是通过为每种货币构建一个包含4个相关货币对的加权篮子来衡量货币的相对强度，其中直接货币对权重为+1.0，反向货币对权重为-1.0。入场条件和出场条件不适用，因为该工具不开仓交易。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。该工具使用循环缓冲区（circular buffer）存储最近400个数据点，通过CCurrencyPowerIndex类计算每个货币的当前价格均值作为强度值。可视化方面，使用CGraphic图形对象绘制6条曲线（50基准线+5条货币线），Y轴固定在0-100范围内，每100毫秒刷新一次数据。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a currency strength analysis utility. Its core concept measures relative currency strength by constructing a weighted basket of 4 related currency pairs for each currency, where direct pairs receive +1.0 weight and inverse pairs receive -1.0 weight. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable as this tool does not open positions. Position sizing and money management are similarly not applicable. The tool uses a circular buffer to store the most recent 400 data points, calculating each currency's current price average via the CCurrencyPowerIndex class as the strength value. For visualization, it uses CGraphic to render 6 curves (a 50-baseline plus 5 currency lines) with the Y-axis fixed at 0-100 range, refreshing data every 100 milliseconds via a millisecond timer.

parameters.name: MINITE_BARS_COUNT
parameters.description: 分钟K线数量，用于自定义符号后缀和数据计算周期
parameters.description_en: Minute bar count for currency strength index calculation period

pros: 实时可视化五大货币强弱，直观展示货币间相对动量差异，辅助交易决策
使用循环缓冲区管理历史数据，内存效率高且避免频繁数组重分配
加权篮子方法合理，直接对权重+1、间接对权重-1的逻辑符合货币对定价原理
pros_en: Real-time visualization of five major currency strengths, intuitively displaying relative momentum differences to assist trading decisions
Uses circular buffer for historical data management, ensuring memory efficiency and avoiding frequent array reallocations
Weighted basket approach is sound, with direct pair +1 and inverse pair -1 logic conforming to currency pair pricing principles
cons: 不执行任何交易操作，仅作为分析工具使用，对期望自动交易的用户价值有限
硬编码了5种货币和20个货币对权重，缺乏灵活性和可配置性，无法扩展到其他货币
缺少数据有效性检查和错误处理，如自定义符号创建失败或数据源不可用时的容错机制不完善
cons_en: Does not execute any trading operations, serving only as an analysis tool, limiting value for users expecting automated trading
Hardcodes 5 currencies and 20 currency pair weights, lacking flexibility and configurability, with no ability to extend to other currencies
Lacks data validity checks and error handling, with incomplete fault tolerance when custom symbol creation fails or data sources are unavailable
improvements: 将货币列表和权重配置外部化为输入参数，支持用户自定义货币篮子和权重分配
增加异常处理和重连机制，当自定义符号数据不可用时自动重试或优雅降级
improvements_en: Externalize currency list and weight configuration as input parameters, allowing users to customize currency baskets and weight allocations
Add exception handling and reconnection mechanisms, enabling automatic retry or graceful degradation when custom symbol data is unavailable

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
高频定时器（100ms）可能在低性能环境下导致资源占用过高
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, posing no financial risk
High-frequency timer (100ms) may cause excessive resource usage on low-performance environments
